limitations: Screening of the current 223 rendered vascular identities only. Different artery/vein types, excluding opposite explicit sides; extent-only pruning, with no triangle-count exclusion; translation-only bounding-centre alignment in source mm and at most 128 deterministic samples per direction to every comparison triangle, with degenerate-face fallback. No scale, rotation, reflection or topology equivalence test. Similarity is a source-review signal, not evidence of copying, wrong anatomy, vascular correspondence or patient registration. No sampled match is clinical validation, and no flag automatically removes or admits tissue.
